description: Client-side script for managing USP agent settings in a web UI, including data retrieval, table layout, form handling, validation, and saving configurations.
external_files: jquery plugins or custom scripts for lang_load, update_table, pop_dialog, switcher_handler, warning_control, loading_control, logout, close_dialog, page_save, ValidateIPaddress

methods.name: insert_agent_item
methods.description: Inserts or updates an agent item in AGENT_DATA array.

methods.name: get_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful data retrieval, copies data and populates AGENT_DATA.

methods.name: get_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for data retrieval error (empty implementation).

methods.name: page_initial
methods.description: Initial page setup, triggers data fetch.

methods.name: agent_table_layout
methods.description: Populates the agent data table with current AGENT_DATA.

methods.name: update_agent_item
methods.description: Opens dialog to update or create agent item.

methods.name: agent_item_layout
methods.description: Populates form fields with agent data for editing or prepares for new entry.

methods.name: save_agent_item
methods.description: Saves agent data from form into AGENT_DATA and triggers save process.

methods.name: set_obj_data
methods.description: Sends data to API for saving.

methods.name: page_save
methods.description: Prepares and sends data to save current AGENT_DATA.
